drhp.business: The company manufactures and trades FMCG agro-food staples — besan, chana dal, atta, poha, suji, maida, daliya, sattu, puffed rice and murmura — alongside cold-pressed mustard oil, spices, pickles and ghee. It reaches the market through three routes: branded consumer retail packs, professional besan grades in 35 kg sacks for mithai shops, halwais and food manufacturers, and D2C micro-factories that mill, grind and press to order for delivery within minutes. Operationally it is a single segment confined to India, served by four Delhi facilities.

currentContext.expansion: Expansion in FY 2025-26 was funded by a maiden IPO that raised Rs. 34.09 crore in a 100% fresh issue, stated by the Managing Director as giving balance-sheet strength to fund working capital, reduce borrowings and invest in growth. The company's manufacturing footprint stands at four Delhi facilities, the fourth of which added integrated retail-ready packaging at scale in 2024; the Mundka Industrial Area unit is dedicated to puffed grains and cereals under the Super SS brand, and dedicated chana dal production was added in 2021. The signature FY26 addition was India's first mini dark factory — a micro-manufacturing unit embedded inside a residential society that mills atta, grinds spices and presses oil to order for delivery within minutes. The stated forward roadmap has three named elements: expand the D2C dark-factory network, commission a dedicated namkeen plant, and launch a premium customised sweets brand — each described as building on capabilities the company already owns. The Board's Report adds an intent to pursue expansion in domestic as well as international markets. No commissioning dates, project costs or capacity figures are attached to any of these projects in the annual-report text provided.
